newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian Air sees positive 1996 pretax.
newsitem.headline: Austrian Air sees positive 1996 pretax.

text.p: Austrian flag-carrier Austrian Airlines was likely to report a pretax profit for the full year despite having suffered a heavy loss in the first half, supervisory board chief Rudolf Streicher said on Monday.
"Austrian Air will be able to report a positive result," he told journalists. "We won't fly brilliantly through the year, but there won't be a crash either."

Austrian Air last year reported pretax earnings of 64.9 million schillings. It recently cut its forecast for 1996 pretax profit to about 160 million schillings, from a previous estimate of 300 million.
In the first half, the carrier had a pretax loss of 313 million schillings, compared to a loss of 141 million in the year-ago period. -- Vienna newsroom +431 53112 274
